1.consolidated_definition: Tesis doctoral. Escrito detallado y metódico presentado a una universidad para obtener el grado académico de doctor. Desvío semántico, usual. Se restringe el significado más general de DRAE 2001: escrito, lección o conferencia en que se expone una materia. Nuestros grados de doctorado requieren de 38 a 66 horas-crédito, aprobar un examen comprensivo o de grado y la presentación de una disertación o tesis doctoral (Universidad Interamericana, octubre 2007)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Doctoral dissertation. A detailed and methodical written presentation submitted to a university for the purpose of obtaining the academic degree of doctor. Semantic deviation, common. The meaning is restricted to the more general sense of DRAE 2001: a written work, lecture, or conference in which a subject matter is expounded. Our doctoral degrees require 38 to 66 credit hours, passing a comprehensive or qualifying examination and the presentation of a dissertation or doctoral thesis (Inter-American University, October 2007)
